title: Walking Someone Else's Dog
sentences: My neighbour broke her ankle in October and could not walk her dog.
I offered to take him out, though I had never owned a dog.
He is large, friendly and completely uninterested in my instructions.
For the first week he pulled me along the whole street.
A woman in the park showed me how to hold the lead properly.
After that things improved, at least most of the time.
I have come to enjoy the walks more than I expected.
I notice things in the neighbourhood that I used to drive past.
My neighbour is walking again now, so my job has ended.
I still look for him whenever I pass her window.
